node: Grid construction labor, utility field services, inspection, installation robotics, and labor-productivity tooling
summary: Expanded the universe around the grid execution labor-productivity node with one direct specialty-contractor reference name and three underfollowed or shadow-lane candidates. The strongest node fit is PLPC because it ties transmission hardware to robotic installation systems, directly matching the hypothesis that installation repeatability and reduced lineworker exposure can become a bottleneck-adjacent value pool. MYRG is the cleanest public small/mid-cap contractor reference for transmission and distribution field execution. NVEE and WLDN are lower-attention second-order candidates in inspection/geospatial and planning/software/program-management layers; both need stronger evidence that grid execution throughput, not generic infrastructure demand, is driving revenue.
